items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: CUNY was under the piano, Martin was sitting at the piano trying to fix the pedals.

ctx.x: But this is interesting. You've brought up your names.

Oh, I wouldn't want to. I wouldn't know. A musician is bound to have strange experiences. I played places I was afraid to go in. For instance, the man in Miami from Charmpton Beach, which is Patterson, Louisiana. You heard of him? Are you available? Yes. Some of you are particular. I demand a deposit. I drive up to the place, I say, it can't be possible. But after they turn the lights on and all the society people come in there, it's a beautiful place. They've got a good band and a good crowd. It's the same as…
